heroHeadline: Ménaka Urban Standoff Day 14 — FAMa Airstrikes as ISSP Holds City; JNIM Hits Benin Military Post; Soufan Center: Mali Pivoting to Turkey/China/Iran Drones After Africa Corps Failure
heroSubtitle: Two weeks after ISSP (Islamic State Sahel Province) seized Ménaka's urban core on April 28, FAMa launched airstrikes on May 12 against ISSP motorcycle columns but ground forces remain besieged at the former UN camp — Mali's longest urban jihadist occupation in the current conflict phase. Separately, JNIM attacked a military post in Porga, northern Benin on May 7, killing 7 soldiers in one of the most significant confirmed strikes on a Gulf of Guinea coastal state. The Soufan Center's May 12 analysis documents Mali's active procurement pivot toward Turkish, Chinese, and Iranian drone systems after Africa Corps failed across all primary objectives in the week of April 25–30. The Djibo assault aftermath (100+ killed, May 11) remains the most acute humanitarian and security emergency in Burkina Faso's modern history.
